final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT r.ordervault AS ov, u.acctscope AS sc, COUNT(*) AS c FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = r.ordervault JOIN users u ON u.userstamp = o.userlink GROUP BY r.ordervault, u.acctscope), s2 AS (SELECT sc, SUM(c) AS total FROM s1 GROUP BY sc), s3 AS (SELECT SUM(total) AS gt FROM s2), s4 AS (SELECT s2.sc AS sc, s2.total AS total, 1.0 * s2.total / s3.gt AS ratio FROM s2 JOIN s3 ON s3.gt IS NOT NULL), s5 AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS av FROM s4) SELECT s4.sc, s4.total, s4.ratio, 1.0 * s4.total / s5.av AS ratio_to_avg FROM s4 JOIN s5 ON s5.av IS NOT NULL
